details: For every nonempty finite class, the stronger bound $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|-1$ holds.
proof: For each target h, choose one disagreement coordinate against every other concept. This gives a teaching set of size at most $|\mathcal H|-1$ which is consistent with no other concept. Assigning these samples to all targets is no-clashing, since two distinct concepts cannot both be consistent with either assigned sample.
name: Size / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
